```plato
//==
// # Noise
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - IProcedural noise
//  - Basis noises
//  - Fractal noises
//  - Warped and derived noises

//==
// # IProcedural noise
//
// Pseudo-random fields for texturing, terrain, motion, and scattering. Every
// noise value type is a deterministic function of its parameters and Seed:
// the same inputs always reproduce the same field. Scalar noises nominally
// range over [-1, 1] unless a doc comment says otherwise. Frequency scales
// the input domain: higher frequency means smaller features.
//
// This section holds the shared noise vocabulary — the basis-function family
// and the Worley selectors — that every noise field type below is
// parameterized by.

// The basis function family of a noise field.
type NoiseBasis = White | Value | Perlin | Simplex | Worley | Gabor;

// The distance metric Worley (cellular) noise uses between a query point and
// feature points
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minkowski_distance).
type WorleyDistance = Euclidean | Manhattan | Chebyshev | Minkowski;

// Which feature-point distances Worley noise combines into its output:
// F1 is the distance to the nearest feature point, F2 to the second nearest;
// F2MinusF1 highlights cell borders.
type WorleyFeature = F1 | F2 | F2MinusF1 | F1PlusF2;

//==
// # Basis noises
//
// The single-octave noise fields: uncorrelated white noise, lattice value and
// gradient noises, cellular (Worley) noise, and band-limited Gabor noise. Each
// is a deterministic function of its parameters and Seed, and each is the
// building block the fractal sums below layer.

// Uncorrelated planar random values: a distinct pseudo-random number per
// point, with no spatial coherence. Ranges over [0, 1]
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_noise).
type WhiteNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Uncorrelated spatial random values: a distinct pseudo-random number per
// point, with no spatial coherence. Ranges over [0, 1]
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_noise).
type WhiteNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Planar value noise: random values on an integer lattice, smoothly
// interpolated between lattice points. Cheap, but shows lattice artifacts
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Value_noise).
type ValueNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}

// Spatial value noise: random values on an integer lattice, smoothly
// interpolated between lattice points. Cheap, but shows lattice artifacts
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Value_noise).
type ValueNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}

// Planar Perlin gradient noise: random gradients on an integer lattice with
// smooth interpolation. Zero at lattice points; band-limited and visually
// smooth (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perlin_noise).
type PerlinNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}

// Spatial Perlin gradient noise: random gradients on an integer lattice with
// smooth interpolation. Zero at lattice points; band-limited and visually
// smooth (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perlin_noise).
type PerlinNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}

// Planar simplex noise: gradient noise on a triangular lattice. Fewer
// directional artifacts and cheaper in higher dimensions than Perlin noise
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simplex_noise).
type SimplexNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}

// Spatial simplex noise: gradient noise on a tetrahedral lattice. Fewer
// directional artifacts and cheaper in higher dimensions than Perlin noise
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simplex_noise).
type SimplexNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
}

// Planar Worley (cellular) noise: distances to randomly scattered feature
// points, one per lattice cell. Jitter in [0, 1] moves feature points from
// cell centers (0) to fully random positions (1). Produces cellular,
// crystalline, and cracked patterns; output is non-negative
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worley_noise).
type WorleyNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Jitter: Number;
    Distance: WorleyDistance;
    Feature: WorleyFeature;
}

// Spatial Worley (cellular) noise: distances to randomly scattered feature
// points, one per lattice cell. Jitter in [0, 1] moves feature points from
// cell centers (0) to fully random positions (1). Produces cellular,
// crystalline, and cracked patterns; output is non-negative
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worley_noise).
type WorleyNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Jitter: Number;
    Distance: WorleyDistance;
    Feature: WorleyFeature;
}
```
